basis: A local rustc reproduction confirms the existing explicit drop(sender) is captured by the thread::scope closure and closes the channel on unwind; the originally suspected generic reporter-thread deadlock is not reproduced. The Evidence stage is nevertheless reported directly on the extraction worker, bypassing bounded event acknowledgement and stage-panic propagation. This bounded correction makes channel ownership closure-local and routes Evidence through the same acknowledged stage-event protocol as other extraction stages.

changes: Move the bounded stage channel into the scoped closure so its unwind lifetime is explicit.
Report Evidence through the existing stage-event acknowledgement path.
Add focused regressions for a panicking provider and a panicking Evidence progress callback; retain the existing original-panic-resumption assertion.

invariants: preserve stage ordering and synchronous reporter-before-provider behavior
preserve the original reporter panic payload when stage acknowledgement fails
preserve provider panic propagation through existing worker join semantics
no public API, persistence, or DAG changes

verification.rustfmt: rustfmt --edition 2024 passed for the three scoped Rust files
verification.cargo: not run; root owns integrated build and focused regressions
verification.repro: Repository-local rustc scoped-thread reproduction completed; explicit sender drop closed the receiver during unwind and scope returned, so generic deadlock was not reproduced

acceptance: Open; exact callback-child scope addendum only, pending root build and regression run.
